description: This file defines functions and variables for handling XML-RPC requests related to ad delivery in the Revive Adserver project. It includes method signatures, environment setup, and request processing for different XML-RPC versions and methods.

methods.name: OA_Delivery_XmlRpc_View
methods.description: Handles ad view requests via XML-RPC, processes parameters, sets environment variables, calls MAX_adSelect, and returns ad HTML and cookies.

methods.name: OA_Delivery_XmlRpc_SPC
methods.description: Handles SPC ad requests via XML-RPC, processes environment info, zones, and calls MAX_adSelect for each zone.

methods.name: OA_Delivery_XmlRpc_View_Max
methods.description: Handles legacy XML-RPC ad view requests for older versions, processes parameters, calls MAX_adSelect, and returns ad HTML and cookies.

methods.name: OA_Delivery_XmlRpc_View_PAN
methods.description: Handles legacy XML-RPC ad view requests for version 2.0, processes environment info, calls OA_Delivery_XmlRpc_View, and returns ad HTML and cookies.
